blurb: Aslin Beer Company operates five taprooms in Herndon, Alexandria, Washington DC, Pittsburgh, and Virginia Beach. Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers on tap, to-go sales, and food from their in-house kitchen concept IZZI, which serves pizza, burgers, salads, and sandwiches. The taprooms feature indoor and outdoor seating, including beer gardens and rooftop bars, and host live music and private events.
